main_text.l: Inchoatio, siue collectio huius Regni durat ab initio
mundi usq; ad eius finem, quia semper in hoc mun-
do sunt aliqua Ecclesiæ membra, siue pauca siue mul-
ta. Consummatio, seu perfectio huius Regni durabit inde a
glorificatione piorum in æternum usque. Deinde erit
finis, quum tradiderit Regnum Deo, ac Patri, scilicet quod
ad hanc formam administrationis illius Regni.

page.notes: Marginal references on the right are copied as printed. "1.Co. 15.14" and "1.Thes.4.17." are uncertain readings. Page number "44" is uncertain: the final digit looks like a reversed or damaged figure. Words in the body have a few uncertain forms, such as "aduenias" and "aduenìat", which I have not marked where they are plain. The running head printed "GRATITVD", changed to "GRATITUD" by the u/v rule. The small mark near the section 9 heading is not printed text and is left out.
